value.deck: Visual Studio Code version 1.133 has been released by Microsoft, delivering targeted performance optimizations and feature updates to the open-source editor ecosystem.
shortVersion: Microsoft has published release notes for Visual Studio Code version 1.133, detailing performance updates and functional improvements across the open-source editor platform. The vendor documentation establishes that this monthly iteration focuses on core editor enhancements aimed at developer workflow efficiency.

Given the platform user base of millions of daily developers, incremental runtime and editor updates directly influence tooling throughput across software teams. The report establishes feature and performance modifications in this build, though precise architectural changes require reviewing the canonical documentation.

While broad productivity gains are implied, specific benchmark numbers and underlying codebase modifications remain unquantified in the high-level release summary. Engineering teams should audit extension compatibility and performance profiles within their local development environments.
